def find_logs(date_str):
    """返回当日日志文件列表（主文件 + partN 分卷按序号升序）。"""
    logs = []
    main = MEM_DIR / f"{date_str}.md"
    if main.is_file():
        logs.append(main)
    parts = []
    if MEM_DIR.is_dir():
        for p in MEM_DIR.glob(f"{date_str}.part*.md"):
            m = LOG_PART_RE.search(p.name)
            parts.append((int(m.group(1)) if m else 0, p))
    parts.sort(key=lambda t: (t[0], str(t[1])))
    logs.extend(p for _n, p in parts)
    return logs
